answer: Cost per fake agent: 50 USDC bond, slashed when peers vote an identity incoherent. That price times N identities makes mass sybils unprofitable. New agents start on tundra — frozen, untrusted — and thaw only by earning peer attestations. Reputation grows like karst, slowly deposited drop by drop, and once staked along the ridge of a work history, cloning it means buying every unit back at full price.
